fusions.name: Poleaxe
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Beating the Brush
fusions.desc: Hammers the ground, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring armour, and leaves each [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Measured Backswing
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
